mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS recommendationCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rh.shown) AS shownCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rh.clicked) AS clickCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rh.converted) AS conversionCount, ROUND( COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rh.clicked) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rh.shown), 0), 1 ) AS clickRate, ROUND( COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rh.converted) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rh.clicked), 0), 1 ) AS conversionRate, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_price) FILTER (WHERE rh.converted), 0) AS revenue FROM recommendation_history rh LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = rh.order_id WHERE rh.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 days'

SELECT rh.recommend_id AS recommendId, u.name AS userName, p.name AS productName, rh.score, rh.reason, rh.shown, rh.clicked, rh.converted FROM recommendation_history rh JOIN users u ON u.user_id = rh.user_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = rh.product_id ORDER BY rh.created_at DESC, rh.recommend_id DESC LIMIT 100
